explanation_en: A standard Spanish (Ruy Lopez) opening idea: White's bishop pins the knight on c6 to the king on e8 along the b5-c6-e8 diagonal.

intro.popup: 💡 西班牙开局（鲁伊·洛佩兹）！白方用象牵制黑马与黑王的经典走法，观察b5→c6→e8斜线牵制。
intro.popup_en: 💡 The Spanish Opening (Ruy Lopez)! White's classic bishop pin targets the knight and king along the b5-c6-e8 diagonal.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Bb5沿b5-c6-e8斜线牵制黑马Nc6——黑马动则黑王被将。白方随后Bxc6换子，破坏黑方兵形，获得持续主动权。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Bb5 pins the knight on c6 to the king on e8 along the b5-c6-e8 diagonal. White can later exchange with Bxc6, damaging Black's pawn structure and keeping the initiative.

moves.popup: 白兵e4，开放游戏，占据中心。
moves.popup_en: White advances the e-pawn, opening the game and occupying the center.

moves.popup: 黑兵e5，对称应对，双方各占中心一格。
moves.popup_en: Black replies with e5. Both sides occupy central squares symmetrically.
White develops the knight to f3, attacking e5.

moves.popup: 黑马Nc6，保护e5——注意这个马即将被白方牵制！
moves.popup_en: Black develops the knight to c6 to defend e5. This knight is about to be pinned.

moves.popup: 白象Bb5！西班牙开局的精髓——沿b5-c6-e8斜线牵制黑马！黑马若动，黑王直接被将。这是全牵制（目标是王）！
moves.popup_en: White plays Bb5! This is the heart of the Spanish Opening: the bishop pins the knight on c6 to the king on e8. If the knight moves, Black's king is in check. This is an absolute pin.

moves.popup: 黑方d6，巩固e5，暂时不理会牵制。
moves.popup_en: Black plays d6 to reinforce e5, temporarily ignoring the pin.

moves.popup: 白兵d4！白方打开中心，向e5施压，同时进一步激活Bb5的牵制。
moves.popup_en: White plays d4, opening the center and increasing pressure on e5 while reinforcing the bishop's pin.

moves.popup: 黑象Bd7，挑战白象——若白象被换，Nc6就解除牵制。
moves.popup_en: Black plays Bd7 to challenge the bishop. If the bishops are exchanged, the pin on the c6-knight will be removed.

moves.popup: 白象Bxc6！主动换子——消灭被牵制的黑马，让黑方兵形双叠。这是利用牵制的换子策略！
moves.popup_en: White plays Bxc6! White exchanges the bishop for the pinned knight, doubling Black's pawns. This is a strategic way to exploit the pin.

moves.popup: 黑象Bxc6回吃——黑方兵形遭到破坏，c6和c7两个兵叠在一起，长期劣势。
moves.popup_en: Black's bishop recaptures on c6, leaving doubled pawns on c6 and c7 and a lasting structural weakness.

moves.popup: 白马Nc3发展，白方完成出子，局面优势明显。西班牙开局的牵制策略取得成功！
moves.popup_en: White develops the knight to c3 and completes development with a clear advantage. The Spanish Opening pin strategy has succeeded!
